text:
tom: FYI FinBank POC hit blocker: intermittent TLS timeouts to our PrivateLink endpoint from their app stack. Need quick triage.

leah: Is this an interface endpoint in their account? Any ENI IPs or flow logs?

tom: Yes, interface ENI IPs 10.1.4.21/22. They sent curl output: TLS handshake starts then hangs until proxy returns 504. No obvious DNS NXDOMAIN.

oscar: Common culprits: endpoint policy restricting principals, SG/NACL flips, or their inline proxy connection pooling causing stale sockets. Ask for VPC flow log and the endpoint policy.

tom: They shared flow snippet: ACCEPT for SYN then REJECT on subsequent packet series. Also endpoint policy only allows a specific role arn, but their proxy uses instance role.

leah: That endpoint policy explains denials. For a POC change we recommend allowing the VPC principal (vpce-*) or widening to '*' while testing. Also temporarily open SG to their app CIDR.

oscar: Meanwhile they reported TLS inspection—proxy replacing certs with corp CA. Their app validates CN and pinned certs so fails. Workaround: bypass inspection for the endpoint IPs or give them a static NAT EIP we can allocate so they can allowlist dest IP and bypass proxy path.

infra-bot: Action queued: allocate-temp-eip -> started.

tom: Sent guidance to customer: 1) update endpoint policy to allow vpce principal, 2) open SG to app CIDR for 443, 3) disable TLS interception or allowlist the EIP we provide.

infra-bot: Allocation complete: EIP 3.120.45.77, nat-id nat-0bb3c1.

tom: Customer applied SG/policy changes and allowlisted 3.120.45.77. Re-tested:
$ curl -v --resolve "api.finbank.local:443:10.1.4.21" https://api.finbank.local/health
* Connected
* TLS handshake completed
{"status":"ok"}

leah: Good. Follow-ups: write runbook for sales: endpoint policy snippet, SG/NACL checklist, proxy bypass options, and Dedicated peering pricing note. Close swarm once runbook created.

oscar: I'll draft runbook and attach to the ticket. tom: confirm demo date?

tom: Demo Wednesday. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
